messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] SmartRouting policy ERROR: Unhandled region pin + fallback loop detected for customer tenant-731. Rate of fallback events spiked 4x in the last 10m. Pager: @sara :rotating_light:
sara: i'm on it. getting the oncall context now. seeing a spike in 5xxs and duplicate responses for some requests.
mike: which region is being forced? i see a manual override in the audit logs: force-region=ap-south-1 by @alice-eng at 1845679900.
alice-eng: that override was to stabilise a hot node during a maintenance window. i thought we set a temporary rollback at +30m. looks like it didn't clear.
kevin-sre: hmm that manual pin triggered cross-region fallback which is mapping traffic to two compatible variants simultaneously -> duplication. i'm seeing request ids repeated with different model-variant headers. logs: ```
[2026-08-12T12:31:40Z] req=abc123 route=chat model=redwood-alpha-v2 variant=quant-8 region=ap-south-1
[2026-08-12T12:31:41Z] req=abc123 route=chat model=redwood-alpha-v2 variant=fp16 region=eu-west-1
```
jess: customer-ops reported 3 customers noticing doubled responses in the last 8m. @customer-ops any more details?
customer-ops: two enterprise customers (tenant-731, tenant-402) saw duplicated outputs; both reported confusion and one ran dedupe logic which throttled them unexpectedly. severity: customer-visible, medium.
sara: immediate mitigation plan — stop new pins and revert the stale override, then throttle cross-region fallbacks for the affected tenants and drain duplicated backend slots. can someone perform the rollback?
mike: i'm about to run undo but want a confirmation. command i plan: ```sh
redwoodctl override release --scope=region --region=ap-south-1 --actor=oncall --reason="unstable pin causing dup traffic" --dry-run=false
```
alice-eng: that will remove the forced pin, but note that autoscaler might reroute back instantly and cause a short spike. we should also temporarily flip fallback policy to prefer single-path routing: ```yaml
fallback_policy:
  mode: prefer_local
  max_parallel_fallbacks: 0
```
kevin-sre: i'll push that fallback tweak as a short-lived policy via console and set TTL 15m. doing now. ETA ~60s.
incident-bot: action logged: policy_change by kevin-sre at 1845680050 (fallback_policy prefer_local, ttl=900s)
mike: override removal in progress... `redwoodctl` returned success for release at 1845680105.
alice-eng: manual check on node pools — draining duplicated sessions from ap-south-1 now. command: `kubectl drain node/staging-infer-12 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=30`
jess: monitoring customer feedback and metrics. dup-response-rate falling from 4x to 1.1x over last 90s.
customer-ops: tenant-731 confirms duplicates stopped, still seeing a few retry artifacts. tenant-402 asks for incident summary and ETA for full cleanup.
sara: good. next steps: 1) leave prefer_local policy for 15m, 2) audit overrides to find why rollback timer didn't clear (suspect race in override-service), 3) run a targeted eval on the affected route to check output regressions. assigning: @alice-eng audit, @kevin-sre policy roll, @mike followup with customers.
mike: pinging tenant contacts, will offer a short explanation + mitigation steps. also adding a temporary rule to drop duplicated responses in the edge proxy for 30m as a safety net.
kevin-sre: noted. creating follow-up job to revert prefer_local after TTL expires and to alert if duplicates reappear.
alice-eng: audit shows override-service failed to persist the expiry due to a clock skew exception during write: ```
ERROR override-service: failed to set expiry for override id=ovr-873: nats write timeout (deadline exceeded)
```
sara: Root cause likely combination of manual pin + transient store failure -> stale override -> routing divergence. We should add a safeguard: force pins require server-side confirmation of expiry persisted; if not, auto-unset and page. filing post-incident task.
jess: will capture timeline and severity, starting a PSIRT card and drafting customer note.
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (customer-visible impact reduced). paging: resolved? :white_check_mark:
sara: leaving channel now. if anyone sees duplicate responses reappear, escalate immediately and do an emergency rollback of the fallback policy config. thanks team :heart: 
kevin-sre: follow-up items: postmortem owner = alice-eng, due in 72h. I'll add monitoring for duplicate response patterns.
alice-eng: got it, will include the exact audit logs and a proposed fix for override-service expiry handling.
mike: closing loop with customers and sharing the short note.
